member_of.name: Leon Hughes and his Coasters (his own touring group)

podcast.title: Original Member of The Coasters
podcast.body: Leon Hughes was an original member of The Coasters, but he was replaced by Cornel Gunter in 1957, prior to the release of "Yakati Yak." "When we last left the coasters, they'd just taken on two new singers. Cornel Gunter and Doug Jones, to replace Leon Hughes and Bobby Nun."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Surviving Original Member
podcast.body: As of the present day, Leon Hughes is identified as the only surviving original member of The Coasters, though he had left the group by the time of their hit "Yakati Yak." "Leon Hughes who is the only surviving original member of the coasters but was gone by the time of Yakite Yak, Tors as Leon Hughes and his coasters."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Tours with His Own Group
podcast.body: Leon Hughes currently tours as "Leon Hughes and his Coasters," one of three separate Coasters groups actively performing. "Leon Hughes who is the only surviving original member of the coasters but was gone by the time of Yakite Yak, Tors as Leon Hughes and his coasters."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
